description: Search Magic: The Gathering cards by name (substring), set code, rarity, type, or format legality. Returns a paginated list with prices and basic metadata. Use this for catalog lookups; for a specific printing prefer get_card with set+number.

format.description: Filter to cards with a legality entry in this format (e.g. 'modern', 'commander').

legality.description: Used with 'format'. Defaults to 'legal' when format is set.

q.description: Substring to search card name + flavor name. Optional; omit to filter purely by setCode/rarity/type/format.

type.description: Substring match against card type line (e.g. 'Goblin', 'Instant').

name: search_cards
